rows.title: Subdivision light-up: >=10 lifetime-sales threshold, sales history, per-subdivision stats, noindex below threshold, ci:sitemap-resolvable
rows.remaining: STATS LEG — exact §0 scope mapped this session (2026-07-23), do NOT build naively: market_stats_cache still has 0 geo_type=subdivision rows. The compute RPC public.compute_and_cache_period_stats (supabase/migrations/20260425090000) ALREADY accepts geo_type=subdivision, but (1) it scopes a subdivision by lower("SubdivisionName")=lower(p_geo_slug) — NAME-ONLY, no city qualifier — so same-named subdivisions across cities COLLIDE/merge (a §0 data-accuracy disaster); (2) the readers key subdivision rows by the composite slug subdivisionEntityKey(city,sub)=slugify(city):slugify(sub) (e.g. bend:tetherow — the /subdivisions/[slug] route slug passed to getMarketStats), which the RPC neither parses nor stores → write-key != read-key, so the page would never find the row even if written; (3) NO caller passes geo_type=subdivision today (the refresh-market-stats cron passes neighborhood, which the RPC RAISE-EXCEPTIONs on). §0 SPOT-CHECK RESOLVED the SFR scare: the city cache median IS SFR-accurate (Bend rolling_365d cache median 725,000 == manual SFR-only 725,000, NOT all-types 696,700), so NO PropertyType filter change is needed. THE FIX (one fresh session): give the RPC subdivision path NON-LOSSY city+subdivision-name scoping (reverse-slugify is lossy for names with apostrophes/special chars — pass exact city + SubdivisionName params, or resolve them cron-side and store geo_slug=the composite key so read==write), enumerate qualifying subdivisions (>=10 lifetime sales via get_subdivision_status_counts, SUBDIVISION_INDEX_MIN_LIFETIME_SALES) in the daily refresh-market-stats cron with monthly/quarterly/ytd + a rolling loop mirroring the neighborhood block, then §0-VERIFY each subdivision RPC output against a manual lower(City)+lower(SubdivisionName) close-window query before flip. Mechanism to add: the cron in vercel.json + a test/gate asserting geo_type=subdivision rows exist for qualifying subs. This is a production SECURITY DEFINER migration whose correctness = published subdivision market stats, so it needs dedicated §0 verification, not an exhausted-context rush. | (Prior note: Two promised pieces absent: (1) the per-subdivision market_stats_cache backfill — the page reads getMarketStats({geoType:'subdivision'}) (page.tsx:360-368) but nothing writes subdivision rows (app/api/cron/refresh-market-stats* cover cities+region only; SubdivisionSalesHistory.tsx:11 admits 'null fo)
